title: Sparkling Water 12-pack

drivers.name: Store closure (Monday)
drivers.evidence: Store closed Monday (1/7 of week). Post-promotion week average: 24% below baseline (noise-adjusted x0.76); apply 1/7 of that to estimate impact.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 94.3. Thanksgiving (Thu) is a minor uplift driver with a noise-adjusted effect of x1.0 (based on 3 past occurrences, all near 1.0). The store closure on Monday reduces demand: 1/7 of the week is lost, and the prior week after a promotion shows 24% below baseline, so the closure lowers sales by ~14%. No price change or promotion. The classical model suggests no uplift, but the closure is a clear negative driver. Adjusting downward for the closure only. Evidence is thin for the holiday, so shrink toward 1.0. Final median adjusted downward.
